fix.new: Tourist boats head for a needle-shaped limestone rock rising out of the sea, which everyone now calls 'James Bond Island' because a villain's lair was filmed there. Which country is it in?
fix.why: 'Tourist boats there' refers to a place not yet named; awkward when read aloud.

fix.new: Khao Phing Kan is an island in Thailand, in Phang Nga Bay northeast of Phuket. The islands are commonly known in English as James Bond Island.
fix.why: Excerpt matched to the corrected source page.

fix.new: The white Lotus that turns into a submarine in The Spy Who Loved Me was sold at auction in 2013 for nearly a million dollars. The buyer, a famous tech entrepreneur, said he wanted to make it transform for real. Who bought it?
fix.why: Hammer price was 550,000 pounds (about 870,000 to 990,000 dollars), so 'nearly' is accurate.
Original excerpt misread an article id in the URL as the price; this source quotes Musk directly.

fix.new: "I was disappointed to learn that it can't actually transform. What I'm going to do is upgrade it with a Tesla electric powertrain and try to make it transform for real."

Musk bought the original underwater prop, which had sat forgotten in a storage unit for years until someone bought it blind for about 100 dollars. He said he was disappointed to learn that it couldn't actually transform, and planned to fit it with a Tesla electric drive.
fix.why: Musk's disappointment was that it can't transform, not that it can't drive into the sea.

fix.new: Odysseus blinds the Cyclops, who screams for help. The other Cyclopes come running, then shrug and walk away. What had Odysseus told the Cyclops his name was?
fix.why: 'What name had Odysseus given him' wrongly suggests the Cyclops was renamed.

fix.new: When Polyphemus shouts that 'Nobody' is hurting him, his neighbours decide nothing is wrong. One of the oldest wordplay jokes in literature saves Odysseus's life.
fix.why: 'Ancient Greece's oldest name joke' is an unverifiable superlative.

fix.new: Godzilla Minus One won Best Visual Effects, the franchise's first ever Oscar, seventy years after the original film. Its budget was a small fraction of the Hollywood films it beat.
fix.why: 'First Oscar in 70 years' wrongly implies an earlier win.
